notes.title: Steam Deck Support Patch Incoming!
notes.content:
Hey everybody! 

We’ve just released a maintenance patch for the game, including a few UI fixes and on-going work for Steam Deck support. Plus upon finishing the game there’s a little teaser for JUSTICE SUCKS, the spiritual successor to Roombo!

The game is now playable on Deck, but a little more work will be needed before we get officially Deck verified. Please let us know if you run into any issues on Deck! 

Changelog:

 Improved UI scaling for different aspect ratios
 Steam Deck support
 Several UI fixes
 Slightly increased cursor speed
 Added teaser video when completing the main game


Thank you for your continued support! If you enjoyed Roombo, please check out JUSTICE SUCKS to continue your bloody vacuum adventures! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/856890/JUSTICE_SUCKS_Tactical_Vacuum_Action/

Much Love,

Samurai Punk <3

notes.title: The spiritual successor to Roombo, JUSTICE SUCKS is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Robot vacuum action evolves in JUSTICE SUCKS, the spiritual successor to Roombo: First Blood! It's a brand new game that continues and expands upon the original concept. We were thrilled with how much you all loved Roombo and wanted to give you more, so we've partnered with tinyBuild to bring you this hot new digital entertainment experience. 

We took on feedback about the things you liked, the things that needed improvement, improved pretty much every aspect of the game and included a full story-mode with plenty of exciting locations to explore and munch up bad guys! 

While we were unable to use the name "Roombo" for the sequel, we hope you fall in love with our renamed robotic friend, Dusty McClean, in JUSTICE SUCKS! 

More details in the announcement post below from our publisher! 

Much Love,
Samurai Punk 
<3

--

Release the killer robot vacuum! 
JUSTICE SUCKS is live on Steam now!

Join Dusty on his adventure:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/856890/JUSTICE_SUCKS_Tactical_Vacuum_Action/

JUSTICE SUCKS is a stealth/action game about a killer robot vacuum cleaner on a quest for vengeance through a 90s TV universe. 

https://i.imgur.com/GQs3BMM.gif

Watch the release trailer now!
[previewyoutube=PeN01P3aH-Q;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]

To celebrate the release, we are also doing a GIVEAWAY! 
👉Click to join the GIVEAWAY!👈 

RULES:
👍Like and retweet this release announcement tweet.
🥳We are giving 5 lucky winners: 1 key each to the full JUSTICE SUCKS game on a platform you prefer!
⏰You can enter from September 8th to September 15th.
🌏 Open worldwide!

Good luck everyone! We will contact you to deliver the keys when the giveaway ends!
[hr][/hr]
Brimming with nostalgia-soaked visuals and wacky battles, JUSTICE SUCKS guides you through various worlds as Dusty the robot vacuum cleaner and his fighting spirit, Sexy McClean. 

Forget everything you know about vacuum cleaners; Dusty is ready to take the game up a notch. Playing as Dusty, together with his fighting spirit Sexy McClean, you need to hack, hide and suck your way to freedom, protecting the family and restoring the peace. Develop your strategies in a roster of vibrant environments, ranging from a summertime cruise ship to the heavily guarded headquarters of your ultimate enemy, FamilyCorp. 

https://i.imgur.com/3eJ4H92.gif

The enemies differ in styles and powers so make plans accordingly. Electrocute the thieves with power outlets, trap them between sliding doors, knock them down with falling fans; there are unlimited approaches to take. Spot a lazy kitten enjoying the sunshine on the deck? Interact with that furry friend and you may release unexpected killer moves.  

https://i.imgur.com/F6WkqGR.gif

Follow Dusty’s epic adventure as you progress through different stages and defeat the final boss of the evil FamilyCorp. What will be the most powerful weapon for the ultimate battle? Work your way to the last stage and you will be surprised.

https://i.imgur.com/T6O8Zv7.jpg

Play JUSTICE SUCKS in your preferred way, choose from a list of game modes in each map that offer different objectives, enemy categories and resources. Earn an “S” score and make it to the top of the leaderboard. We look forward to seeing your great performances!

Don’t forget to join our communities and chat about the game with fellow players!

 Twitter
 Facebook
 Instagram
 Join Discord
 Tik Tok

Have fun in JUSTICE SUCKS and we will see you in the game!

notes.title: V1.3 Featuring Non-Tank Controls + Steam Trading Cards OUT NOW!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34144185/4d68a8cefaf194ebdd4b026683712b4901c1a90d.png

Hey everybody!

We have some news to share! We’ve been keeping an eye on your feedback, and one of the major complaints we’ve noticed has been the tank controls. Whilst this was a core part of the design, it’s clear that many players do not have a good experience with this control scheme.

New Control Scheme Option - Free Movement
After some debate, we’ve decided to add non-tank controls as an option! This way, players will still be able to experience the original scheme if they would like, or change to an easier “free movement” control scheme. This WILL make the game less challenging, but we think those that use the new “free movement” scheme will still have a great time.

You can select your movement style when you play the first level, or in the in the Options menu! 

The update also includes a host of performance optimisations to allow the game to run better across all machines! And Steam trading cards too! Neat! 

Price Increase
Additionally, we’d like to announce we are planning a price increase to $4.99. We don’t take the decision lightly, but please let me explain:
Our reasoning for the increase is:

 We’ve added several new features (localisation, controller support, optimisations) since initial release
 We would like to bring the Steam version to price parity with the Nintendo Switch version
 The price-point of $2.99 has not been sustainable for our studio. In the past 10 months on Steam, we have only earned equivalent to two weeks worth of company running costs.


The price increase will be taking effect starting August 15th. So please grab the game before then if you'd like it at the lower price. :) 

I hope you will understand our reasoning, and that this slight bump will make a sizable difference for our small team in the long run. The longer we can survive, the more likely it’ll be for us to make new adventures for little Roombo.

Thanks again for your continued support. <3 

Be well and stay safe, friends!

Much Love,
Samurai Punk <3

notes.title: V1.2 Update Out Now - Localisation + General Improvements
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34144185/761ebab843fbf6487dfab39f8a681014ce5ceb85.png

Hey all,

We’ve been smanging away at a patch for Roombo and we’re excited to get these features out to you! 

The language of justice is global, so we figured we’d add some more languages to the game so that more people can experience the magic of slaughtering burglars as a vacuum. 

We’ve added localisation for:

 Simplified Chinese
 Traditional Chinese
 Japanese
 Korean
 French
 German
 Dutch
 Spanish (Latin America)
 Russian


This patch also adds:

 Made TVs and Speakers explosive
 Added basic tutorial for hacking in first level
 Made ram attack more generous
 Various fixes for controller navigation
 More visual effects for Roombo in Sprint mode


Thanks again for supporting Roombo, and to all new and old players, we hope you enjoy! 

Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3

[edit]
Thanks to Freshie44, we fixed an issue where achievements weren't unlocking. 

[edit2]
We have a fix on the experimental branch for the volume settings bug. 

If you'd like to try it, access the experimental branch as follows:
1. Open Steam and go to your games library.
2. Right click on Roombo: First Blood and select "Properties"
3. Navigate to the "Betas" tab
4. Enter password "samuraipunkco"
5. Select "experimental" from the dropdown

Once we've done some more QA and confirmed it's stable, we'll release it to the public. 

[edit3]
Volume settings issue is fixed!

notes.title: Patch V1.1 - Controller Support + Key Remapping + Ultrawide
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34144185/2355c640898b47340e09de67ce5bcbc36172ace4.gif

Hey everybody,

Our new update is live! We've finally added controller support, plus a host of new control features! 

This patch includes:

 Controller support 
 Basic movement tutorial
 Change Sprint / Sneak mode to a toggle
 Rebound “Hack Mode” to Q instead of R
 Adjusted highlight color for hackable items (thanks to Mr.Nigel117 for suggestion)
 Support for DVORAK / AZERTY layouts (Access via Settings menu)
 EXPERIMENTAL: Custom key binding (Access via Settings menu)
 Fix UI for ultrawide monitors
 Fix traps not being highlighted when hovering


We're still open to feedback on these changes so please let us know your thoughts in the forums or Discord! 

Remember you can join the Samurai Punk community at discord.gg/samuraipunk to hang out with the crew and hear the latest news on our games. 

Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3


[EDIT 29/8/19]
We've made a minor change to this patch, changing Sprint/Sneak to a toggle.
